cause_quote: c66da3d added the remount-mapped `previousIdentity = identities?.currentIdentity(initial.descriptor.previous.identity) ?? ...` only after the automatic (`onlyStaleLease`) gate, which kept comparing the raw recorded `[initial.descriptor.previous.identity, initial.descriptor.candidate.identity]` and so declined after a device renumbering.
user_saw: After a reboot renumbered the disk mid-update, every later `openclaw update` or Control UI update failed with update-recovery-pending ('device number changed only') until the user ran `openclaw update repair`.
summary: Computes the remount-mapped previous/candidate identities before the automatic settlement gate so the pre-admission settlement handles device-renumbered journals like `update repair` does.
reasoning: The raw-identity automatic gate came from ff6f58a (#169038), before remount settlement existed; c66da3d (#170046) introduced the verified remount mapping for settlement but applied it only below that gate, so automatic settlement never handled a remounted journal (the PR's regression tests fail on base). 0679b18 (#181307) later widened automatic settlement to interrupted updates but kept the same gate; I attribute to c66da3d as the PR does, with medium confidence because c66da3d deliberately routed remount recovery through repair and which automatic path the reporter hit is not fully confirmed.
